conviction_note: The company's full-year miss is already in the IFIS consensus (ordinary 30,576 vs plan 32,200; OP 31,906 vs 33,500), so tonight turns on the first FY2027 guide and the dividend, where I could not find a street number. The negatives are small (findings sum -0.6) and p_up of 49 on a 3.5% scale gives about -0.07. The two numbers agree in sign. The scaled number is near zero because this company's FY2025 print rose +2.46% even though its guide came in about 5% under the street.
bar: IFIS consensus as of 2026-10-13: FY2026/8 sales 459,046m, OP 31,906m, ordinary 30,576m, NP 17,706m (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9418). The company plan is still the unrevised 2025-10-14 guide: sales 424,000m, OP 33,500m, ordinary 32,200m, NP 18,500m, DPS 17 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9418). There is only one consensus source; I found no FY2027 consensus and no Shikiho number (shikiho.toyokeizai.net returned a JS shell).
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (absent above the 0.5% threshold) as of 2026-09-29, no change (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio 42.51x per kabutan 2026-10-14 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9418), so leveraged retail is heavily long; it is an August 優待 name. There is no option skew in Japan. priced_lean_pct -0.92, almost all of it the margin overhang. Run-up: +2.08% over 20 days, -0.45% over 5 days.

findings.finding: FY2026/8 will miss the company's unrevised plan. Q3 cumulative ordinary profit was 23,728m, 73.7% of the 32,200m plan against a 5-year average of 78.1%, and the plan needs Q4 ordinary of 8,470m (+21.9% YoY). The energy business (segment OP 8,644m vs 15,300m plan, 56%) faced Middle East-driven procurement costs, and JPX's monthly reports describe fuel prices rising again in July and August. The IFIS consensus has already been cut to OP 31,906m and ordinary 30,576m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the Q3 print (2026-07-13, 16:00) Q3 ordinary fell -9.5% YoY and progress was below the 5-year average. The stock moved -0.18% close to next close, then rose on a 2026-07-17 SBI upgrade saying energy weakness was priced.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. IFIS ordinary consensus fell from 32,000m in July to 30,576m on 2026-09-16, about 5% under plan. What remains is the chance that Q4 energy costs land below even that, since JPX reports show fuel prices rising again in Jul/Aug while the company's July deck described JEPX as declining after the June ceasefire. Had the market feared a deeper miss, the stock would not sit +2% over 20 days with 42x margin longs.
findings.independence: Q3 deck, 2026-07-13 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713592051.pdf): energy segment at 56% of plan, and JEPX July 1-12 average 12.98 yen. JPX electricity futures monthly reports (https://www.jpx.co.jp/derivatives/products/energy/electricity-futures/mklp77000000dd24-att/repo_202609.pdf): Jul/Aug fuel prices up. This last one is snippet_only because the PDF returned 403 to curl and WebFetch.

findings.finding: The first FY2027/8 guide comes with this release, and this company sets initial guides under the street. The FY2026 initial ordinary guide of 32,200m on 2025-10-14 was about 5% under the then-IFIS 34,000m, and consensus fell 2.7% within a week. With fighting in the Middle East resuming in July and August per JPX's electricity reports, the energy line is an obvious place to be conservative again. The NBCUniversal Universal+ exclusive starts in September 2026 and adds content cost to FY2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last first guide (FY2026, released 2025-10-14) was about 5% under IFIS and came with the new 'Road to 2030' MTP. The stock rose +2.46% close to next close (Yahoo bars 2074 to 2125), so the last below-street guide was bought.
findings.why_not_priced: No FY2027 consensus is visible on IFIS/kabuyoho, so I cannot say where the street sits. The risk is that analysts extrapolate full-year XING karaoke consolidation (from 2026-04), energy normalisation and content leverage, and the company again guides under them. If that were priced, the stock would not trade at a 2,080 average target with 4 of 5 ratings bullish.
findings.independence: NBCU disclosure 2026-08-31 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260831/140120260831528469.pdf) says the partnership has no FY2026 impact and starts from September 2026, so it falls in FY2027. Inference about cost, not a stated number.

findings.finding: The dividend has risen every year: 5 (FY22), 7.17 (FY23), 11 (FY24), 15.5 (FY25), 17 planned for FY26. The FY2027 dividend forecast comes in this release and another increase is the base case. The company holds 423 treasury shares and has no buyback history.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the FY2025 print the dividend went from 11 to 15.5 and the FY2026 guide was 17. The stock rose +2.46%, together with the MTP.
findings.why_not_priced: A routine increase is expected; the yield is 0.96% at 17 yen. Only a step-change, such as a payout-ratio policy or a first buyback, would be unpriced, and I found no sign of one.
findings.independence: Q3 tanshin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713592044.pdf): FY2026 dividend forecast of 17.00 unchanged.

findings.finding: Margin longs outweigh margin shorts 42.5x (信用倍率 42.51) and there is no disclosed short above 0.5%. The holder base is heavy in leveraged retail (an August 優待 name), so a disappointing FY2027 guide meets forced sellers and nobody is short to squeeze.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 FY2025 print (2025-07-10) fell -9.52% close to next close; that is the name's one large post-print drop on record in the baseline window.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the baseline's margin_overhang component (-0.81), so it is largely in priced_lean already. I file it only as a skew to the downside tail and not as an independent call.
findings.independence: The baseline margin_ratio comes from the same kabutan figure; same source, counted once.

outside_window.finding: Revenue upside and benefits from the NBCUniversal Universal+ exclusive (library from September 2026, new theatrical titles from spring 2027) build through FY2027 and are not measurable at this print.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the margin-overhang lean (-0.92) and do not beat it. The strongest positive this release could carry is a FY2027 guide showing double-digit OP growth from full-year XING karaoke consolidation and energy normalisation, plus a dividend raise. I looked for it, and the last first-guide print (FY2025, guide under the street) was bought +2.46%, so a sign-neutral p_up is right.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public 進捗率): the FY2026 plan-miss finding went from -0.3 to -0.1 because the miss is computable from the Q3 短信 and already in IFIS

Rules 1 and 2 (negatives outnumber positives; write the strongest positive): p_up went from 47 to 49, so the scaled number went from -0.21 to -0.07; the guidance, dividend and positioning findings were left unchanged
